product.name: Room of Days
product.promise: Focus can borrow the room's quiet musical bed when chosen, while silence stays one obvious tap away.
owner_quotes: and make sure the new music fable added in is well incorporated too. i was thinking of adding the meditation music it generated to a meditation/focus timer stuff (and then allow the user to easily turn it off too)

shared_dna.transient: No new transient; the continuous bed never voices a tap.
shared_dna.body: The existing Room modal voice and detuned-sine air remain the only musical body.
shared_dna.harmonic_field: The existing 28-bar, 60 BPM Room phrase is unchanged.
shared_dna.texture: Quiet synthesized air with no imported samples.
shared_dna.space: The existing Room bus and restrained tail remain unchanged.
shared_dna.dynamics: The bed stays below conversation and event sounds at the shipped 0.35 player gain.

mix.rapid_policy: Focus music has one looping voice and cannot retrigger or stack.
mix.ducking_policy: The focus bed remains the lowest-priority voice and never replaces completion or reminder meaning.
silence_policy: Focus opens silent unless the saved global preference is already on.
The visible Focus control can quiet the bed for this session without rewriting the saved preference.
Backgrounding pauses the bed and restoring the app resumes only if the current choice still wants music.
mix.compound_outcome_rule: Music state changes are continuous mix changes; accepted taps keep the existing interaction cue family.
mix.voice_stealing_rule: Only one background-music transport exists; newer session and lifecycle intent serializes after older starts.
mix.state_dedupe_rule: Repeated on or off requests reconcile to the current combined global, session, mute, and foreground state.
mix.settings_rule: Music is optional and defaults off until chosen. Focus opt-in and Focus quiet are ephemeral; global preference is preserved. SFX and music remain independent.

contact.recipe: No new contact asset; use the shipped Room interaction sound system.

body.recipe: Deterministic project-authored synthesis documented in the steward-supper-music-v1 manifest.

space.recipe: Existing Room bus and encoded room-theme.m4a loop.

signature.recipe: Existing modal voice plus detuned-sine air; no additional layer.

render_contract.variant_axis: No variants; one approved technical master with state-controlled gain.

cues.meaning: Support a chosen period of focused or meditative time without demanding attention.
representative_actions: Turn Room music on inside a timer-verified Focus session
cues.timing: Fade in after the explicit choice and fade or pause when quiet is chosen.
cues.gesture: One quiet continuous room bed, never a confirmation sound.

layer_plan.derivation: Use the shipped room-theme.m4a unchanged through the single BackgroundMusicController.

cues.motion: The visible Room music row changes state with the existing quick response curve.
silent_when: Neither the global preference nor Focus session opts in

auditions.context: Run a 25-minute Focus timer with ordinary taps, completion, backgrounding, and session quiet.
auditions.question: Does the bed belong to the same room, stay beneath actions, loop cleanly, and become genuinely silent in one tap?

provenance.policy: Original project synthesis only; preserve the existing manifest and asset hash.
